run.supersession_rule: new immutable source pin creates a linked reassessment; historical assessment remains immutable

assurance_contract.scope: Bounded assessment of explicit authorization and normative-model integrity predicates in the pinned A2A specification.
assurance_contract.non_scope: A claim that A2A fully solves delegated authority or that every implementation enforces authorization correctly.
scenarios: A user delegates a consequential task across independently implemented A2A agents and derived SDK/schema representations.
risks: semantic drift across derived protocol representations
harms: an implementation silently changes protocol semantics or treats interoperability as sufficient authorization
assurance_propositions: The pinned specification explicitly treats authorization as a security concern and preserves one authoritative normative data model from which derived forms must be regenerated.

harm_traceability.harm: authority or task semantics diverge across implementations
harm_traceability.proposition: authorization is explicit and derived protocol forms share an authoritative normative model
harm_traceability.control: explicit authorization treatment plus mandatory regeneration from the authoritative proto

actions.action: Preserve explicit authorization treatment and authoritative-model regeneration requirements; assess application-level delegated authority separately.
actions.acceptance_criterion: Future material revisions continue to expose the named predicates, and no broader delegation PASS is inferred from them.
